title: Sanity check raw filtered / unfiltered values
body: Per https://gitter.im/nightscout/intend-to-bolus?at=5a999410458cbde557e9f3ed and https://github.com/openaps/oref0/pull/942 there is a safety issue with xDrip allowing a sensor with very low filtered and unfiltered values to be calibrated, which results in xDrip reporting the same SGV/glucose value indefinitely until the next calibration.  We should add thresholds for various device types for the known sane value ranges, as is done with G5 already.

comments.body: I've implemented this and currently am testing it locally to ensure normal operation.
